cs.t: From mass market brand road bikes I'm quite partial to Giant. I just bought a Defy Advanced 2. Truly an excellently designed and engineered machine. From custom builders my bros Black Sheep Bikes Road Rage Downhill custom was and is the best bicycle I've ever had the pleasure of riding. Link for the curious:  http://www.spoke.ie/2011/10/red-bull-road-rage-janos-kohler-...
